content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Assistant: Post graduate degree in Biological Science or relevant subject/field. Desirable: 1-year experience in relevant subject/field/Medical Laboratory. Working knowledge of Computer application (Excel/Word/Power point). Project Technical Support II: 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT or equivalent) + Five Years’ Experience in relevant subject/field (Medical Laboratory) OR Three Years Graduate degree in Biological Science or relevant subject/field + two years’ experience in medical laboratory/relevant subject. Desirable: Working knowledge of computer applications (MS Office), blood sample collection, sample processing and analysis, data management, and electronic data handling.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts. Age Relaxation: SC/ST: 5 years; OBC: 3 years; PwBD General: 10 years; PwBD OBC: 13 years; PwBD SC/ST: 15 years. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Research Assistant: Rs. 27,000/- (Consolidated without any allowances) Per Month Project Technical Support II: Rs. 24,000 (Rs 20,000 + 20% HRA) Per Month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Rajkot?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for AIIMS Rajkot recruitment is scheduled for 14th September 2026. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for specific reporting times.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Assistant / Project Technical Support II posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by AIIMS Rajkot for the positions of Junior Research Assistant and Project Technical Support II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary for each post. For Junior Research Assistant, a postgraduate degree is required. For Project Technical Support II, a 12th pass with a diploma or a graduate degree with experience is needed.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Rajkot recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by AIIMS Rajkot.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 24,000 to Rs. 27,000 per month, depending on the specific post and its requirements.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Rajkot recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes a written exam or skill test, followed by an interview, document verification, and the final merit list preparation.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the AIIMS Rajkot office. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact address and reporting time.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates, along with self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job is contractual in nature, as indicated in the official notification released by AIIMS Rajkot.
